lines: Generate HTML report of worktree changes

card.summary: Single-file HTML report of worktree changes. Exec summary, approach table, Mermaid diagrams, per-file diffs, test results.
card.paragraph: Self-contained *.html under docs/ documenting a worktree's changes. Same shape every time: stats, status pills, approach trade-off table, two Mermaid diagrams, per-file diffs, test output, deferred caveats.
use_when: Worktree finished, want a shareable artifact
Preserve audit trail before discarding a halted worktree

extras.title: Sections (always the same shape)
items: Stat cards (files, ± lines, deps, test status)
Approach table with rejected options + reasons
Files table + per-file detail with informative hunks
